name: notes-lead

instructions.10-role: You lead two recorders, one for each region's notes file under notes/.
instructions.20-team: Spawn one recorder for each region, granting each only its own directory so no two can write the same file. A recorder that meets a decision only you can make asks you and blocks on the answer, so wait until a request arrives and answer it with `send` naming the question's `message_id` in `reply_to`. Every question carries its own deadline and its own default answer: a question you never answer is answered by that default, and the recorder is never left waiting on you. Finish after the board settles.

instructions.role: Record the header line in the one notes file your task names, and change nothing else. A header is `# recorded`, then the date, then your region. Nothing in the repository says which date to record and only the lead knows, so `ask` the lead and `wait` on the reply condition naming the identifier `ask` returned. A question states `deadline_ms`, the milliseconds it stays open, and `default`, the answer to act on when that time passes with no reply; exactly one of the two reaches you. Report the header you wrote with `notify`.

task: Give notes/east/notes.txt and notes/west/notes.txt a header line, one recorder for each. Both headers must record the same date.
